tools.name: agents_list
tools.description: List configured agent ids with name/model/runtime metadata, allowed as `sessions_spawn(runtime:"subagent")` targets.

tools.name: agents_wait
tools.description: Wait for collector subagents started by sessions_spawn collect=true. Accepts many run ids; returns once any completes (completed results incl. structured output, plus pending ids), or on timeoutSeconds.

awaitResults.description: Join required collector results until settlement or cancellation, without polling; mutually exclusive with timeoutSeconds. Child and agent budgets still apply.

tools.name: apply_patch
tools.description: Patch one/many files. Input requires *** Begin Patch and *** End Patch.

input.description: Patch content using the *** Begin Patch/End Patch format.

tools.name: ask_user
tools.description: Ask the human user 1-3 structured questions and wait for their answer; `multiSelect` allows picking several options and `timeoutSeconds` bounds the wait. Use only when blocked on a decision genuinely theirs that cannot be resolved from the request, code, or sensible defaults; never ask whether to proceed or confirm a plan. Ask exactly one question per call unless several answers must be submitted together; one single-select question uses native controls on supported messaging channels. Put every selectable choice in `options`, never only in the question text. Put the recommended option first and suffix its label with ` (Recommended)`. Use `multiSelect` only when the user may choose several options at once; otherwise omit it. Do not include an Other option; free text is added automatically. If the result is no_answer, continue with best judgment.

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum human wait in seconds; default 900, clamped 30-3600. Earlier run cancellation or overall run timeout still applies.

offset.description: Job offset for action="list"; use nextOffset to load the next page
